description: This file defines the interface for the Rialto control component, including the IControl and IControlFactory classes, which provide methods for creating control instances and registering clients for control operations. It also includes licensing information and references to external headers.

classes.name: IControlFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IControl.

classes.name: IControl
classes.description: Interface defining control operations, including client registration.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create a factory instance for IControl.

methods.name: createControl
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create an IControl instance.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Method to register a new control client and obtain the current application state.
